claims.text_en: BTS Chit Lom (E1) is an elevated Sukhumvit Line station opened on 5 December 1999 on Phloen Chit Road at the Chit Lom junction (Phloen Chit, Chit Lom and Lang Suan roads) in Pathum Wan district, near the Ratchaprasong intersection in Lumphini subdistrict, and the name is also rendered 'Chidlom'.

geography.notes: Station is the entity's anchor; the surrounding area spans Lumphini subdistrict (Pathum Wan) with the Pratunam edge reaching into Ratchathewi district.

temporal_scope.notes: Opening date stable; ridership figures fluctuate year to year.

evidence.paraphrase: Station on the Sukhumvit Line, code E1, opened 5 December 1999, located on Phloen Chit Road at Chit Lom intersection to Lang Suan and Chit Lom Road, Pathum Wan district; coordinates 13.7441N 100.5431E.

evidence.locator: บทนำ / ที่ตั้ง (lead and location sections)
evidence.paraphrase: Thai Wikipedia: elevated BTS station on the Sukhumvit line, service began 5 December 1999 (พ.ศ. 2542), west of the Chit Lom junction, near the Ratchaprasong intersection in Lumphini subdistrict.

limitations: English article carries March 2026 maintenance banners about sourcing
2021 ridership of 3,154,058 quoted in infobox is a pandemic-year low

claims.text_en: The station is an unusually well-connected skywalk node: nine access points include a direct skybridge to Central Chidlom and a 7.5 m-wide, 513 m-long skywalk (about 260 million baht invested by Central Pattana) linking the Ratchaprasong intersection, CentralWorld and onward toward Siam station.

geography.notes: The elevated network is the connective spine of the whole unit.

temporal_scope.observed_period: skywalk in place since the 2010s; links verified 2026

evidence.locator: ทางเดินลอยฟ้า / ทางเข้า-ออก (skywalk and exits sections)
evidence.paraphrase: Skywalk 7.5 m wide and 513 m long links the station to Ratchaprasong intersection, CentralWorld and Siam station; Central Pattana invested roughly 260 million baht; nine station entrances/exits including bridges to Grand Hyatt Erawan, InterContinental, Holiday Inn, Renaissance, Mercury Tower, Gaysorn, Central Chidlom, Central Embassy and Big C Ratchadamri.
Station linked by skybridge directly to Central Chidlom and by Sky Walk to Ratchaprasong intersection (CentralWorld, Gaysorn, Erawan Shrine) and to Siam station.
Chit Lom Station connects to Central Chidlom, Maneeya Center, Grand Hyatt Erawan, Gaysorn and CentralWorld; the walkway extends to Siam Station.

limitations: Per-segment lengths between individual malls are not published
Skywalk reach does not by itself measure street-level walkability (see chit-lom-c15)

claims.text_en: The Erawan Shrine (Thao Maha Phrom Shrine), housing the four-faced Phra Phrom statue enshrined on 9 November 1956, stands at the Ratchaprasong intersection beside the Grand Hyatt Erawan, is overlooked by the Chit Lom elevated walkway, and is one of several Hindu shrines that give the junction its 'Intersection of Gods' character.

geography.notes: Adjacent to the skywalk; unambiguously within the unit.

evidence.paraphrase: Shrine houses the Thai representation of Brahma; statue enshrined 9 November 1956 as part of the Erawan Hotel development; located at Grand Hyatt Erawan, Ratchaprasong, in Lumphini subdistrict, Pathum Wan; Chit Lom station's elevated walkway overlooks it; five other Hindu deity shrines are in the area.
Operator page describes worship of all four faces in four directions, offerings of lotus, water and candles, and hired Thai dance troupes performing for answered prayers.
Ratchaprasong lists Erawan Shrine plus Lakshmi, Trimurti, Ganesha, Indra and other shrines, nicknamed the 'Intersection of Gods'.

limitations: Wikipedia article's infobox coordinates initially mismatch; footer coordinate 13.744361N 100.540444E is the shrine

claims.text_en: A bomb detonated at the Erawan Shrine on the evening of 17 August 2015 killed 20 people and injured about 125; the shrine reopened within two days, and in June 2026, after a trial lasting more than a decade, a Thai court sentenced two Uyghur men to death for the attack.

temporal_scope.notes: Verdict is under appeal per the BBC report.

evidence.paraphrase: Three-kilogram TNT device detonated 18:55 near the shrine, killing 20 bystanders and injuring 125; statue slightly damaged; shrine reopened after repairs within two days, a speed that drew criticism.

Court convicted two Uyghur men of planning and detonating the bomb on 17 August 2015 that killed 20 and injured more than 120; trial lasted over ten years partly due to translator shortages; both allege torture-induced confessions; appeal announced.

limitations: Casualty tallies differ slightly between reports (125 vs 'more than 120')
Security-camera failures and investigation criticisms noted by sources

claims.text_en: Ratchaprasong has repeatedly been a mass-protest flashpoint: the 2010 red-shirt occupation of the intersection ended in a 19 May 2010 military clearance with roughly 90 deaths and CentralWorld burned, and the intersection again hosted protests in 2014 and during the 2020-2021 demonstration wave.

temporal_scope.notes: The brief's 'big bike-protest at Erawan' variant could not be confirmed; see open issues.

evidence.paraphrase: Red-shirt protesters occupied the area around Ratchaprasong from March to May 2010 ('the red city'); the army cleared the intersection on 19 May 2010 with roughly 90 civilian and soldier deaths and CentralWorld partially destroyed by fire, rebuilt by June 2012; demonstrations against the Yingluck government in 2014; the area again saw demonstrations during the 2020-2021 Thai protests.

limitations: Thai and English searches found no mainstream confirmation of a 'big bike' convoy protest specifically at Erawan Shrine; vehicle-convoy (car mob) protests are documented for 2021 in general
2010 death toll is approximate in the source

claims.text_en: The shrine operates as a daily devotional site where worshippers hire Thai dance troupes to give thanks, and since March 2020 incense and candles have been banned on the site for health and air-quality (PM2.5) reasons.

temporal_scope.observed_period: ban in force since 2020-03 and still in effect per 2025 Thai reporting
temporal_scope.notes: Thai-language searches in January 2025 reported the measure entering its seventh year.

evidence.paraphrase: Worshippers honour all four faces in four directions with offerings such as lotus flowers and water; the shrine often features Thai dance troupes hired by worshippers whose prayers were answered.

evidence.locator: 2020 ban on incense and candles section
evidence.paraphrase: Beginning March 2020, incense and candles were no longer allowed to be lit at the shrine due to health and environmental concerns.

limitations: PRD (thainews.prd.go.th) confirmation of the 2025 seventh-year continuation was unreachable (DNS failure), so the 2025 continuation rests on search-engine descriptions of it plus the Wikipedia ban record

temporal_scope.notes: Supports the brief's lead 1 hypothesis with evidence.

evidence.paraphrase: Two-bedrooms at the luxury benchmark tower run 70,000-120,000 THB; 120,000 is that building's ceiling for a standard 2-bed layout.
Across 47 Chidlom listings, ordinary two-bedroom quotes appear at 45,000 (Na Vara), 85,000-100,000 (Somkid Gardens, The Park Chidlom) and upward, i.e. many two-bed quotes sit well below 120,000.

limitations: No published median rent for the corridor was found; the inference compares clusters, not a computed median
PropertyScout's page shows area rents 'lower than Bangkok average' for every size class, an anomaly not reconciled here
All figures are asking rents

temporal_scope.notes: Works status as of the report date; ground conditions may since have changed.

evidence.paraphrase: BMA spokesperson Ekwaranyu Amrapal said 16 routes of sidewalks are being improved, naming Ratchadamri, Phloen Chit and Udomsuk; a photo caption notes renovation 'including Ratchaprasong'; sidewalks historically 'notorious for being uneven, easily damaged, and often a tripping hazard'; 1,000 km goal with 10 new standards (10 cm ramps, tactile paving, drainage changes).

limitations: Reports the city's own progress framing; no independent walkability audit cited

question_answers.notes: Aliases: Chit Lom / Chidlom (Thai ชิดลม). Station in Pathum Wan district (Lumphini subdistrict for the Ratchaprasong side); the Platinum/Pratunam edge crosses into Ratchathewi (c13). Named corridors: Phloen Chit Rd, Rama I Rd, Ratchadamri Rd, Lang Suan Rd, Chit Lom Rd. Clearly inside per sources: Erawan Shrine, Central Chidlom, Gaysorn, CentralWorld, Grand Hyatt, Amarin; edge cases for the coordinator's polygon pass: Platinum (partial), Lumphini Park (outside on centre distance, north edge closer), Scope Langsuan/Tonson projects.

The distinctive everyday experience is commerce fused with devotion: office workers and tourists circling the four-faced Brahma with hired dance troupes (c03, c06) while commuting on a 513 m skywalk threaded through malls (c02). Whose: worshippers, retail workers, shoppers, hotel guests.

What people value, by mechanism: zero-transfer mall-to-mall reach (verified skywalk engineering, c02); restaurant density on quiet sois (c10, guide opinion); rooftop views (c11, guide opinion); a rebuilt flagship for one-stop retail (c12, operator claim). Guide opinion vs fact separated by claim kind.

Deliberate counter-evidence: street-level sidewalks historically a tripping hazard with renovation ongoing (c15); wholesale crowds and long trading days at the Platinum edge (c13); rents at the top of the market (c07); and a protest/bombing history at the intersection itself (c04, c05). Unsuitable for budget renters and seekers of quiet residential streets.

Rhythm inferred from posted hours and devotional practice: shrine devotion through the day (c06), mall core 09:00/10:00-20:00/22:00 (c18), bars from late afternoon (c18). Weekday/weekend and seasonal splits not verified — flagged in c18 limitations.

Walk-to-transit reality: nine station access points and direct skybridges to Central Chidlom, Gaysorn, hotels and CentralWorld make the elevated access unusually good for the corridor (c02, c01); at street level the BMA itself called sidewalks notorious and was mid-renovation in 2024 (c15). Skywalk covers the corridor, not the side sois. No walking times were derived from the 800 m radius.

Daily-life support is retail-heavy: Central Chidlom flagship with food/beauty floors and 10:00-22:00 hours (c12, c18), Big C Ratchadamri hypermarket with fitness centre and cineplex (c16), Police Hospital adjacent (c16), dense upmarket dining (c10). Ordinary everyday groceries skew premium rather than wet-market.

Affordability: only asking rents available; November 2026 Chidlom listings 27,000-380,000 THB with a luxury cluster 80k-180k (c07); luxury benchmark tower 2BRs 70k-120k (c08). The app's 120k 2-bed override is top-of-cluster premium stock, not a median (c09). Sample limits: agent-portal snapshots, not signed leases.

Usable green: no named public park in the immediate block across the sources used; Lumphini Park (57.6 ha) is the nearest major park, its centre about 1.5 km south (c14). Tree cover and private gardens (hotel grounds, store theming) are not park access. This supports the brief's lead 4 ('almost no named park') and sits in tension with the app's green 9 — a scoring discussion for the coordinator, not changed here.

Conditional fit: strong for car-free corporate expats, diplomatic staff and luxury shoppers who will pay upper-market rents (c17, c09) and value skywalk reach (c02); poor for budget renters (c09), park-and-quiet seekers (c14) and anyone allergic to wholesale-mall crowds at the Pratunam edge (c13). No universal 'best-area' claim made.

Recent changes: 4bn-THB Central Chidlom transformation announced Dec 2024 completing through 2025 (c12); BMA sidewalk programme covering Ratchadamri/Phloen Chit with Ratchaprasong under renovation, 2024-2025 (c15); Sato San rooftop opened New Year's Eve 2025 (c11); 2015-bombing death-sentence verdict June 2026 (c04); Peninsular Plaza closed 2022 (c16). Event vs publication dates kept separate in each claim's temporal_scope.

Uncertainties: asking-vs-signed rent unknown and no corridor median published (c07, c09); PropertyScout's below-Bangkok-average anomaly unreconciled (c09); polygon membership of Platinum edge, Lumphini north edge and Lang Suan projects unresolved (c13, c14); the 'big bike protest at Erawan' lead unconfirmed in either language (c05 limitations); app green 9 vs named-park absence tension (c14). Outside the score: the June 2026 verdict's appeal (c04).

editorial.preview: A commerce-first skywalk junction where a Brahma shrine draws worshippers between two luxury department stores, and the nearest big park is about 1.5 km down Ratchadamri Road (chit-lom-c03, chit-lom-c14).
editorial.guide_lead: Chit Lom is the Ratchaprasong node where retail and ritual share one junction: a BTS station with nine access points, a 7.5 m-wide, 513 m-long skywalk strung across CentralWorld, Gaysorn and the Grand Hyatt, and the four-faced Phra Phrom statue enshrined there since 1956 (chit-lom-c01, chit-lom-c02, chit-lom-c03). The trade shows up in rents that run from 27,000 THB studios to six-figure two-bedrooms in towers like Magnolias Ratchadamri, where 120,000 THB is the ceiling of the standard two-bedroom range rather than a corridor median (chit-lom-c07, chit-lom-c08, chit-lom-c09). Street level is the weaker layer: the BMA called city sidewalks historically a tripping hazard and was still renovating Ratchaprasong in 2024 (chit-lom-c15). It rewards corporate expats and shoppers; it taxes budget renters and anyone hunting for a park (chit-lom-c14, chit-lom-c17).

strengths.text_en: Elevated connectivity is verified engineering, not brochure copy: nine station access points and a 513 m, 7.5 m-wide skywalk link Central Chidlom, Gaysorn, CentralWorld and on to Siam station without a street crossing (chit-lom-c02).
Restaurant density on the quiet side sois is unusually high for central Bangkok — 8 of Time Out's 50 best sit on Phloen Chit, Lang Suan and Ratchadamri, led by Inddee at No. 8 (chit-lom-c10).

Everyday retail is deep: Central Chidlom reopened as a 4-billion-baht 'Store of Bangkok' flagship with a Sky Terrace straight onto the BTS, and Big C Ratchadamri adds a hypermarket, gym and cineplex (chit-lom-c12, chit-lom-c16).

tradeoffs.text_en: Rents are the tax on the address: November 2026 listings ran 27,000-380,000 THB with the luxury cluster at 80k-180k, and the app's 120k two-bed is premium-building ceiling stock rather than a corridor median (chit-lom-c07, chit-lom-c08, chit-lom-c09).

The crowd score has two engines: the shrine's daily devotional flow with hired dance troupes, and the Platinum Fashion Mall's 09:00-20:00 wholesale trade at the Pratunam edge (chit-lom-c06, chit-lom-c13).

Skywalk gloss does not extend to the pavement: the BMA itself described sidewalks here as historically uneven and a tripping hazard, with Ratchaprasong still under renovation in May 2024 (chit-lom-c15).

day_night.text_en: Daytime belongs to worship and wholesale: shrine visitors circling all four faces of Phra Phrom while Platinum's seven wholesale floors trade from 09:00 (chit-lom-c06, chit-lom-c13).

Evenings thin out into hotel bars rather than street nightlife — Red Sky from 16:00 on the 55th floor, Sato San on the Moxy's 32nd, Speakeasy on Lang Suan — with the mall core closing between 20:00 and 22:00 (chit-lom-c11, chit-lom-c18).

The block has absorbed political weather before: the 2010 crackdown, the 2014 protests and the 2020-2021 wave all used this intersection, and the 2015 bombing still shapes its security memory through the June 2026 verdict (chit-lom-c04, chit-lom-c05).

within_area_variation.text_en: Lang Suan and the side sois run quieter and restaurant-led, while the Ratchaprasong corridor is mall-and-shrine dense (chit-lom-c10, chit-lom-c03).
The northern Pratunam edge flips register entirely: Platinum's wholesale crowds and Ratchathewi-district pavements rather than flagship retail (chit-lom-c13).
Green access differs by degree, not kind: tree-lined streets and private gardens everywhere, an actual park only about 1.5 km south at Lumphini's centre (chit-lom-c14).

conditional_fit.text_en: Fits corporate expats, diplomatic staff and long-stay professionals whom agents describe as the tenant base, and who can carry upper-market rents (chit-lom-c17, chit-lom-c09).
Fits car-free shoppers and hotel guests who will live on the skywalk network (chit-lom-c02).
Does not fit budget renters priced out at 45k+ for ordinary two-beds, nor families wanting a park within the block, nor seekers of club-district nightlife (chit-lom-c07, chit-lom-c14, chit-lom-c11).

uncertainties: All rent figures are asking prices; no signed-lease or median data was found, so the app's 45k/120k references cannot be validated against transactions (chit-lom-c07, chit-lom-c09).

Polygon membership is unresolved for the Platinum/Pratunam edge, Lumphini Park's northern corner and the Lang Suan projects; the coordinator's geometry pass decides these (chit-lom-c13, chit-lom-c14).
The 'big bike protest at Erawan' lead could not be confirmed in English or Thai mainstream coverage; only general 2020-2021 protest and 2021 car-mob history is documented (chit-lom-c05).
PropertyScout's portal shows area rents below its Bangkok average for every size class, an anomaly left unreconciled (chit-lom-c09).

open_issues: Coordinator polygon checks needed: whether Lumphini Park's northern (Sarasin) edge, the Platinum/Pratunam edge, Magnolias Ratchadamri and the Lang Suan projects (Scope, Muniq, Tonson) fall inside the app's 800 m unit.

Brief lead 2 ('big bike-protest/temple-event history at Erawan') unconfirmed: Thai and English searches found no mainstream report of a big-bike convoy protest at the shrine; documented event history is the 2006 vandalism, the 17 Aug 2015 bombing (verdict June 2026), the 2010 red-shirt occupation/crackdown, 2014 protests and 2020-2021 demonstrations.
Rent evidence is asking-price-only from three agent portals; a signed-lease or median-rent dataset would settle the override-vs-median question properly.
PropertyScout's 'lower than Bangkok average' rent percentages for every bedroom type contradict the portal's own premium positioning of the area and were treated cautiously.

Access failures this session (logged once each): bangkokpost.com routes to a tollbit paywall endpoint; ddproperty.com returned HTTP 403; fazwaz.com area page 404; two 2015-era BBC URLs 404; tourismthailand.org attraction page returned no content; thainews.prd.go.th failed DNS resolution.
App green 9 vs the 'almost no named park' picture: sources support the absence of a named park in the immediate block; scoring reconciliation belongs to the coordinator.
